mapper.sql: select id, name, icon, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from wl_category
mapper.select: select id, name, icon from wl_category where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by sort_order asc, id asc

del_flag = '0' and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and status = #{status}
order by sort_order asc, id asc
select count(1) from wl_category where name = #{name} and del_flag = '0' and id != #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: insert into wl_category(name, icon, sort_order, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, remark) values(#{name}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{status}, #{createBy}, now(), '', now(), '0', #{remark})
mapper.update: update wl_category set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{operator}, update_time = now() where del_flag = '0' and id in #{id} and not exists (select 1 from wl_document d where d.category_id = wl_category.id and d.del_flag = '0')
